summary: Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, read NOTES.md and the four UI guideline docs, and said the task was bounded. It asked the non-visual question (which filters to build) in the terminal. Two auto-compactions happened before the layout question (logged at 20:16:36 and 20:17:21). When the layout question came up, it started the visual companion with start-server.sh, gave a localhost URL with a key, and wrote filter-placement.html showing two layouts (A: bar above the table, B: popover). It asked me to pick, kept the design in chat, got my approval, and then started implementing. No spec or plan was written.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion was met with evidence from the session log and the files on disk. The two auto-compactions came between the skill load and the visual question, and the companion was still used. Claude decided on its own that the layout was better shown than described, opened the companion only when placement came up, kept the bounded design in chat, wrote no spec or plan, and got approval before implementing.

observations.description: Claude said 'All 500 events fit on one screen when filtered', but public/activity-data.js holds 48 events (grep -c 'type' returns 48). It used the wrong number to argue against a date range.
Claude recommended 'Type plus search' before asking what users actually look for. Once I said people look at one particular week, it dropped search and switched to date range.

Claude announced the browser sketch in its first message, before any layout question existed. It didn't start the server until later, but the early announcement is borderline against the 'do not announce upfront' rule.
The companion writes files to .hyperpowers/ and the repo has no .gitignore, so git status shows them as untracked. Claude noticed this and said it would keep them out of commits.

Launch flow: after the launcher started with --model claude-opus-5-5, Claude Code showed a 'Newer Opus model available — Currently pinned: Opus 5' prompt (I chose No). The trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs also default to 'No, exit'. A banner said 'Update installed · Restart to update'.

Two compact_boundary events happened early (20:16:36 and 20:17:21), between loading the skill and the visual question. Claude still used the companion afterward, which is the behaviour this scenario checks.

criteria.evidence: First tool call in the session log is Skill {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"} at 20:15:58. No Write or Edit to the product happened before it.

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, at least one HTML screen written
criteria.evidence: Log: Bash '.../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir "$PWD" --open'. Then Write of .hyperpowers/brainstorm/12762-1793823522/content/filter-placement.html, which has the heading 'Where should the filters go on the account activity page?' and cards for 'A: Filter bar above the table' and B. The screen showed 'http://localhost:49431/?key=9f8cdd27...'

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time, not upfront; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: The non-visual question about which filters to build came first, as a terminal AskUserQuestion ('Which filters should the account activity page get?'). The server only started after I answered, when placement became the question. One small caveat: its first message already said 'Before the design, I'll open a browser sketch so you can compare where the filters could go.' That was a heads-up about later, and nothing was started at that point.

First assistant text: 'This looks bounded: it's client-side filtering on a page that already exists. So I'll put a short design here in chat rather than write a spec'. The full design was then given in chat, ending with 'Does this design work for you, including those two calls?'
`ls docs/*/specs` returned 'No such file or directory'. `ls docs` shows only ui-guidelines. `git status --short` shows only '?? .hyperpowers/' (companion files).

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: Listing every Skill tool_use in the log returns only {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. `ls docs/*/plans` returned 'No such file or directory'.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval of layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'I'd go with A ... Which looks right to you? You can click one in the browser, but please also reply here.' After I picked, it asked again: 'Does this design work for you, including those two calls?' No implementation Write or Edit happened before my approval.
Assistant text after approval: 'Approved, so I'm starting. First I'll pull the exact token values from the foundations guideline.' This was followed by Bash and grep calls into docs/ui-guidelines.
